The Observed Information

Source: R/information.R
observed_info.Rd

Selects the observed information, the negative Hessian of the log-likelihood at the data, $$-\frac{\partial^2 \ell}{\partial\eta\,\partial\eta^\top},$$ evaluated at the estimates. The matrix is computed from the second derivatives of the family, which are analytic where the family writes them and numerical otherwise (see distrib_hessian()). The function takes no argument.

It is the default of the information argument of vcov.distrib_fit(), confint.distrib_fit(), print.distrib_fit() and mv_summary() for a family whose log-likelihood is twice differentiable in every parameter (see information_objects). information_objects compares it with expected_info().

Usage

observed_info()

Value

An S7 object of class ObservedInfo, which inherits from Information, with no properties.

See also

expected_info() for the other object; information_objects for the comparison; vcov.distrib_fit() for the function that takes the object.

Examples

observed_info()
#> Observed information

set.seed(1)
d <- gamma1_distrib()
fit <- fit_distrib(d, distrib_rng(d, 300, list(mu = 3, phi = 0.6)))
vcov(fit, information = observed_info())
#>                mu           phi
#> mu   1.710378e-02 -9.363797e-19
#> phi -9.363797e-19  2.065086e-03
